title: Clarence Williams as his father's prize pupil
summary: Lee recalls his father speaking of Big Head Clarence Williams, who went to New York, and wonders about Clarence Williams the Third.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Did Clarence Williams go to school at New Orleans University, or did he work with your dad's band or what?

Well, that's what I don't quite understand. See, all I know is that from the time it seems that I can remember, when he was talking about musicians, he would always say Big Head Clarence, you know, he said he was one of my prize pupils and he said that he left and went to New York and became very successful. But he was the guy that he used to talk about, you know, most when I was very small.

Now that's, you know, Cootie and Ben came much later, but this was the man who, when I was very, very small I would hear him talk about. Clarence Williams. And I've always wondered if the young man that was on television -- Clarence Williams the Third, that was -- I forget the name of the show where they had the one black and the white girl and the white boy -- not the Rookies, it was something -- it
was a good show out here, and his name was Clarence Williams the Third. I always wondered if he was any relation. I never got a chance to meet him to ask him.
